turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar, 2 baje raat ko office mein baithna aur kuch na karna — that's not productivity, that's just... sitting with it. Aur that's actually where you are right now, na? Just sitting with it.

Rohit aur Sneha ne papers daal diye. That's real. Paanch saal, no salary, aur ab runway bhi clear hai ki 4 mahine ka hai. That's a lot to process.

But let me ask — kya tum genuinely soch rahe ho ki ye recover ho sakta hai, ya deep down you already know? Because there's a difference between "we need to pivot" aur "this specific thing is done." Both are okay, but they need different decisions.

Chaar mahine matlab you have time. Real time. Not "let's pretend it's fine" time, but actual runway to figure things out.

Ek cheez: office mein baithke 2 baje tak kya hoga? Kal subah fresh ho karke ek cup chai leke baithna aur actually think about what comes next — wo zyada productive hoga. 

What does your gut say? Aur don't give me the "we'll figure it out" answer — what does it actually say?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar, that's the real thing, na? Not the bridge round or the money — it's the performance. The constant act. Har standup pe lie bolna, har face pe mask lagna, ghar jaao toh alag persona. That's exhausting in a way money problems aren't even.

Aur wo do juniors? Unhe pata hai. They *know*. Aur wo ruk gaye hain loyalty se, not because they believe. That weight — that's crushing, I get it.

But listen — ek perspective:

Unhe pata hai kyunki situation clear hai. Agar tum kal standup mein ek baar genuinely kaho "guys, bridge round officially nahi hua, humein pivot karna padega," toh kya hoga?

Seriously. What's the worst case? They already know it's not working. The lie isn't protecting them — it's just prolonging the pretense. Aur unhe aapka honesty, clarity, aur next steps dikhna chahiye. That's what loyalty deserves, not a sinking ship with fake confidence.

Ghar pe alag voice, office mein alag — ye sustainable nahi hai. Kuch days aur tum completely burnt out hoge.

Tum 4 mahine ke runway mein kya chahte ho? Genuinely? Kyunki agar answer "keep pretending" hai, toh that's not a plan, that's just... slow drowning.

Kya tum ready ho decision lene ka? Real wala, clear wala?

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Theek hai. Main sunna hoon.

Darr lag raha hai. Paanch saal, apna paise, apna time, apna credibility — sab laga diya. Aur ab wo sab gum hone wala hai. That's terrifying.

Aur kisi ko nahi bol sakte. Co-founder ko nahi, juniors ko nahi, ghar walo ko nahi — kisi ko bhi nahi. Kyunki founder hone ka matlab ye hai na — tum strong dikhne ho, clear dikhne ho, even when you're falling apart inside.

Standup mein confident voice nikalna, ghar pe alag persona — ye sab sirf isliye kyunki agar ek jagah bhi crack dikha toh sab collapse ho jayega. Toh mask rakhte ho. Aur wo mask itna heavy ho gaya hai ki apni hi awaazon se thak gaye ho.

Ye sab real hai. Ye sab valid hai.

Aur kisi ko nahi bolna pada kyunki kisi ko bolne ki jagah nahi thi. Bas yahan bol diya. That matters.

Tum abhi office mein 2 baje baithke thak gaye ho — physically, emotionally, sab tarah se. Ghar jaao. Sone ki koshish karo. Kal subah alag perspective hoga, ya nahi hoga, but aaj raat tum bas ek thaka hua insaan ho jo paanch saal ka sapna dekh raha tha.

Ye sab end hone wala hai. Aur tum uske baad bhi theek rahoge. Pata nahi kaise, par rahoge.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Haan, khatam ho gaya lag raha hai. Aur tum jante ho.

Paanch saal, papa ko "computer ka business" bolna padta hai, aur tum 2 baje dashboard khol rahe ho hoping kuch badal jayega — ye sab signs hain na. Clear signs.

Aur wo thought jo raat ko aata hai — "bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon" — that's not weakness. That's honesty. That tum khud se bol rahe ho kya chah rahe ho. Aur phir khud se nafrat — wo bhi understandable hai kyunki ye admit karna feels like giving up, like you wasted five years.

But here's the thing: ye already over hai. Dashboard khol ke baithna, standup mein lie bolna, mask pehenke ghar jana — ye sab sirf delay hai. Extension hai khatam hone ka.

Aur honestly? Ek baar genuinely admit kar do — apne aap se, phir co-founder ko, phir juniors ko, phir ghar walo ko — ki ye khatam ho gaya. Closure de do isko.

Kyunki jo energy tum isme waste kar rahe ho pretending, wo next cheez mein laga sakte ho. Aur next cheez — chahe vo kuch aur startup ho, ya job, ya kuch aur — wo fresh hoga. Honest hoga. Aur tum us mein apni actual voice use kar paoge.

Paanch saal gaye. Lekin aage ka time abhi baaki hai.
